chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Isma'il ibn 'Abd al-Khaliq, from one of our companions, from Abu Ubayda, who said:

Sixty years came upon me with no children born for me. So I performed hajj and entered upon Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) and complained to him of that. He said to me: 'Has there truly never been a birth for you?' I said: 'No.' He said: 'When you return to Iraq, marry a woman, and do not worry if she happens to be of poor appearance.' I said: 'And what is the poor appearance?' He said: 'A woman in whom there is ugliness, for they have more children. And supplicate with this supplication, for I hope that God will grant you males and females.'

And the supplication is: O God, do not leave me alone, solitary and fearful, so that my gratitude would fall short of my contemplation. Rather, grant me companionship and a righteous posterity — males and females — through whom I find rest from my loneliness and find comfort from my isolation, and I thank You for the completion of Your blessing. O Bestower! O Magnificent One! O Granter! Grant me good in every circumstance until You bring me to the ultimate of Your pleasure with me — in truthfulness of speech, fulfillment of trust, and loyalty to the covenant.

key_terms.الدُّعَاءُ: the supplication taught by the Imam — a comprehensive invocation addressing loneliness, progeny, gratitude, and virtuous conduct
key_terms.سَوْءَاءَ: a woman of plain or imperfect outward appearance; the Imam clarifies this as a woman with some physical unattractiveness, believed to be more fertile
key_terms.عَاقِبَةَ صِدْقٍ: righteous posterity or a truthful outcome; children who will be good and righteous
key_terms.وَفَاءِ الْعَهْدِ: loyalty to the covenant; in Shia tradition, this often refers to wilayah (allegiance to the Imams)
key_terms.وَهَّابُ: one of the 99 Names of God meaning 'the Great Bestower' — invoked here in context of requesting children

ai.seo_question: What supplication did Imam al-Sadiq (AS) teach to a man who had no children for sixty years?
ai.summary: Abu Ubayda narrates that after sixty childless years, he visited Imam al-Sadiq (AS) during hajj and complained of his condition. The Imam counseled him to marry a woman of plain appearance upon returning to Iraq, explaining that such women tend to have more children. The Imam then taught him a comprehensive du'a asking God for companionship, righteous progeny, and ultimate divine pleasure through truthfulness, fulfillment of trust, and loyalty to covenant.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ismail Bin Abdul Khaliq, from one of our companions, from Abu Ubeyda who said,

‘Sixty years had come upon me and there were no children for me. So I went over to Abu Abdullahasws and complained to himasws of that. So heasws said to me: ‘Or there has never been a birth for you?’ I said, ‘No’. Heasws said: ‘When you proceed to Al-Iraq, so marry a woman, and don’t worry if she happens to be with injury’. I said, ‘And what injury?’ Heasws said: ‘A woman wherein is some ugliness, for she would give abundant births; and supplicate with this supplication, so Iasws hope that Allahazwj would Grant you males and females, and the supplication is, ‘O Allah! [21:89] Do not leave me alone; and You are the Best of inheritors; alone, scared, so my gratefulness would reduce from my thinking. But, Grant me a truthful posterity, males and females, by them (I can come out from) my loneliness, and I can be tranquil from being alone, and I thank you for the completion of the Bounties. O Endower! O Magnificent! O Granter of greatness! Then Grant me gratefulness during every good health until there reaches to me Yourazwj Pleasure from it, in truthful discussion, and fulfilment of the entrustments, and loyalty with the Covenant (Al-Wilayah)’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from ’Isma’il ibn ‘Abd al-Khaliq from certain persons of our people from abu ‘Ubaydah who has said the following:

“I was sixty years old and had no children. I went to perform al-Hajj then visited abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and complained about not having any child. He (the Imam) asked, ‘Has any child ever been born to you?’ I replied, ‘No, it has not happened.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘When you go to Iraq marry a woman and it does not matter if she is not Sawa’. I then asked, ‘What is Sawa’?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is a woman who has certain degree of ugliness because such women give birth to more children and say this prayer. I hope Allah will grant you male and female children,

‘O Lord, do not leave me one, lonely and afraid, so that my thoughts reduce my thanking You. O Lord, (I appeal before You to) grant me comfort, truthful male successors and female ones in whom I can seek tranquility against fear, comfort against loneliness and thank You for completion of bounties. O Magnanimous, O Great , O the One who grants (favors), grant me with every successor goodness until You take me as far as You will be pleased with me in truthful words, safe return of trust and keeping the promise.’”
